{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment turns negative after sustained positive sentiment",
    "Increase forecast amplitude when sentiment diverges from price movement",
    "Lag price reversals to allow momentum to establish",
    "Mean-revert extreme forecasts toward recent price range when sentiment is neutral",
    "Amplify forecast changes when sentiment is strong (positive or negative)",
    "Smooth forecasts on days with conflicting sentiment signals",
    "Pull intermediate forecasts toward historical patterns when deviation from sentiment signal is large"
] }
